units: <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 9:2">Men. IX, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 87b:21">87ᵇ</cite>) <he>ש׳ היו בהין וכ׳</he> the Hin measure in the Temple had marks: so far for the meal-offering to go with the bullock &c.; <cite ref="Bava Batra 86b:6">B. Bath. 86ᵇ</cite>.
Sabb. 80ᵇ אלא אמר … ש׳ but, said R. K., (the andifé of the Mishnah means, enough time to whiten) the marks of a vessel.
